div.div:
Autonomous MCP flow — buy → decrypt, zero human steps
❶ discover_assets — Workers queries the Rights Graph for published assets
❷ buy_access — Workers quotes x402 (HTTP 402 + Rights Receipt terms),
reading the current Owner / License epochs from Hedera
❸ Privy server wallet signs a native-HBAR transfer
(session signer + per-session spend cap; no raw key on Workers)
❹ Workers settles the payment through the Blocky402 facilitator
❺ OperatorTxQueue anchors it — RightsRegistry.settleAndIssue
→ ReceiptIssued + RevenueAllocated (creator + current owner)
❻ decrypt_content — Workers re-reads ownerOf / receiptStatus from Hedera
(authorization is never taken from cache or the subgraph)
❼ ReceiptLock serialises the use — RightsRegistry.consume(receiptHash, useIndex)
→ ReceiptConsumed (exactly-once, even under 20-way replay)
❽ KeyGate releases the blinded key share from KV (share_G) + Secrets (share_U)
❾ MCP client rebuilds K = share_G ⊕ share_U, fetches ciphertext from IPFS,
decrypts AES-256-GCM locally
❿ Rights Graph indexes the new events — discovery / audit only
The browser owner path (apps/web) is the same shape without ❷–❺: prove ownership,
re-read accessEpoch, release the share.
